name: codeql
on: [push]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      matrix:
        language:
          - 'actions'
          - python
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
